# Lecture 01 — Why Projects Fail: The Case for Project Management

## Session topics & takeaways

This session covers:

1. Project success/failure patterns in the software industry
2. Famous failures vs famous successes; what the differences trace back to
3. Scope, time, cost, and quality as competing constraints
4. Why the triangle alone does not explain failure
5. From 'note-taker' to integrator of scope, risk, and stakeholders
6. Value of method vs value of judgment
